headline: Easy breeding chain: Penking
title: Easy Penking Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: Need Penking for your base? Follow these three easy breeding steps. Step one: breed Robinquill with Vanwyrm to get Fenglope. Step two: breed that Fenglope with Grintale to get Katress. Step three: breed Katress with Dinossom, and the egg hatches into Penking! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Penking: Robinquill + Vanwyrm = Fenglope, Fenglope + Grintale = Katress, Katress + Dinossom = Penking. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
